changelog:
alibabacloud-mongodb-instances-manage v0.0.2

- Major update to support full MongoDB lifecycle, including backup, version upgrade, HA switchover, account & tag management.
- Added mandatory AI-Mode enable/disable steps and enforced CLI User-Agent requirements.
- Updated minimum Aliyun CLI version requirement to 3.3.3.
- Improved installation and operation checks, including plugin update command.
- Extended CLI examples, region selection, and operation standards for broader coverage and compliance.
- Expanded triggers to support additional management actions (backup, upgrade, HA, restart, tags, account, etc.).
